change: setup: kings and a locked wall of pawns only; castling removed (no rook stands beside a king).

proof.text: White pawns stand on ranks 3 and 4 alternately across the ten files, each with a black pawn directly above it. Every pawn is blocked head-on, and every pawn's diagonal capture squares hold its own pawn or nothing, so no pawn ever moves or takes. Every pawn a king could reach is protected, and a king may not move into check, so the kings never take and never cross; neither can give check to the other. So no position is checkmate, and stalemate (`rules.stalemate`) is a draw. Mechanically: `labelled/check.py` visits every reachable position (`no_win`) and finds no ending with a winner.
